item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief: Implement `retry_budget.py` according to the repository's `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the basic existing coverage. Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests and commit the finished work on the item branch. Acceptance: all specified behavior and boundaries in SPEC.md are covered, existing tests continue to pass, added focused tests pass, and the work is committed.
